title: Ronin Bridge validator-key compromise
summary: In March 2022, Ronin Bridge was exploited after validator keys were compromised, leading to one of the largest reported bridge losses in crypto history. The incident later became a reference case for bridge validator and cross-chain security risk.
reported_loss_text: Reported as roughly $620 million in public coverage.
amount_note: Public reports commonly cite approximately $620 million; exact valuation depends on asset prices and source timing.

amount_claims.notes: Used as the display loss amount in this seed record.

known_unknowns: Exact loss valuation varies by source and valuation date.
This seed record does not yet include a full reimbursement timeline.

title: BSC Token Hub 2022 forged-proof exploit
summary: In October 2022, an attacker exploited BSC Token Hub by forging a bridge proof, creating and taking two million BNB. The nominal value was nearly $570 million, while BNB Chain later stated that about $100 million remained unrecovered after validators paused and resumed the network.
reported_loss_usd_display: Nearly $570 million minted; about $100 million unrecovered
reported_loss_text: Two million BNB were minted and taken, valued near $570 million; BNB Chain reported about $100 million moved off-chain and remained unrecovered.
loss_amount_basis: nominal minted value separated from estimated unrecovered amount
amount_note: The $570 million figure describes the nominal value of two million BNB created and taken. The approximately $100 million figure describes the amount BNB Chain said remained unrecovered after the coordinated response.

amount_claims.notes: Nominal amount created through the forged-proof exploit.

amount_claims.amount_text: about $100 million moved off-chain and remained unrecovered
amount_claims.notes: Estimated unrecovered amount, distinct from the nominal minted value.

unresolved_reason: The final disposition of the approximately $100 million described as unrecovered is not established in this seed record.
known_unknowns: Final realized economic loss and later recovery or liquidation outcomes require further review.
The bridge was retired later through BNB Chain Fusion, not solely as a direct incident response.

title: Multichain 2023 abnormal MPC asset outflows

reported_loss_usd_display: More than $125 million in abnormal outflows
reported_loss_text: Chainalysis reported more than $125 million in unauthorized withdrawals; other public reporting described the total as nearly $130 million.
amount_note: The seed uses $125 million as the conservative display figure while preserving the higher nearly $130 million public estimate as a range.

title: Orbit Bridge 2024 Ethereum vault exploit
summary: On January 1, 2024, an unidentified attacker removed approximately $81.5 million in ETH, WBTC, USDT, USDC, and DAI from the Orbit Bridge Ethereum vault. The Ethereum vault was shut down, and later recovery and partial service-resumption plans remained incomplete.
reported_loss_text: Orbit Chain reported approximately $81.5 million at the time of the exploit; a later recovery plan rounded the total to approximately $82 million.

title: QBridge 2022 zero-value deposit exploit

amount_note: The $80 million figure is the direct exploit-loss estimate. The $90.8 million figure is a later Qubit damage calculation and is retained as a distinct scope rather than replacing the stolen-asset estimate.

title: THORChain 2021 ETH Router exploit 1

reported_loss_usd_display: $8 million official estimate; $5 million secondary estimate
reported_loss_text: THORChain's official postmortem reported an $8 million impact and about 4,200 ETH siphoned; Rekt reported approximately $5 million in assets taken.
loss_amount_basis: official postmortem prioritized, with lower secondary estimate retained as a conflicting claim
amount_note: Use the official $8 million figure as canonical while retaining the $5 million secondary estimate because contemporary public estimates differed.

amount_claims.notes: Retained as a lower contemporary estimate.

known_unknowns: The exact realized dollar loss depends on valuation timing and whether later operational insolvency effects are included.

conflicting_claims.resolution: Use the official $8 million estimate as canonical and retain $5 million as the lower contemporary estimate.

title: THORChain 2021 ETH Router exploit 2
